app.name: Clock In
app.coreFailed: The app is not responding. Close it and open it again.

notConfigured.title: Server settings are missing
notConfigured.body: This build was made without the connection details. Ask Minas for a new build.

welcome.title: Welcome to Clock In
welcome.intro: This device isn't connected yet. Choose one:
welcome.firstHint: Only once, on the shop's first device. You set the passphrase and the quit code.
welcome.pairHint: For every further device. Needs the employer's passphrase.

setup.title: Set up as first device
setup.passphraseIntro: Type the passphrase: at least 5 English words from the list, separated by spaces. Staff must not learn it.
setup.passphraseMismatch: The two passphrases are not the same.
setup.quitCodeIntro: 4 digits. Asked for when the app is closed, so it isn't closed by accident. It is not secret.
setup.quitCodeMismatch: The two quit codes are not the same.
setup.deviceIntro: How this device appears in the device list.

pair.title: Pair this device
pair.intro: Type the employer's passphrase. It's needed only once on this device.

passphrase.too_short: The passphrase is too short (at least 20 characters).
passphrase.unknown_words: Not in the list: word {{positions}}. Check the spelling.

lockout.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{time}}.

today.noData: No connection, and no schedule has been loaded yet.

confirm.noUndo: This can't be undone. Only the employer can correct it.

banner.offline: Offline. Last sync: {{when}}. Marks are saved and will be sent when the connection is back.
banner.offlineNever: Offline. Marks are saved and will be sent when the connection is back.
banner.clockSkew: This computer's clock is more than 2 minutes off. Check the Windows date and time settings.
banner.horizonShort: The alarm schedule covers less than 3 days. Keep Clock In open and online.

unlock.title: Settings
unlock.reauth: The Settings session ended. Type the passphrase again to continue.

errors.offline: Can't reach the server. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on this computer. Try again.
errors.already_initialized: A first device already exists. Choose "Pair this device".
errors.not_initialized: No first device has been set up yet. Choose "Set up as first device".
errors.invalid_input: The server did not accept the change.
errors.generic: The change was not made. Try again.
errors.device_name: The device name must have 1 to 60 characters.
errors.quit_code: The quit code must be exactly 4 digits.
errors.blocks: Fix the hours that are marked.
errors.range: The value is out of range.

staff.title: Staff
staff.empty: No staff yet. Press "New staff member".
staff.scheduleHint: 24-hour times, e.g. 09:00. If the end is after midnight, type it as is (e.g. 02:00): it shows "(+1)".
staff.removeBody: Remove {{name}}? They disappear from their next shift onward. Their marks are kept for 30 days.

name.no_letters: At least one letter is needed.
name.invalid_character: "{{character}}" is not allowed. Only letters, space, hyphen and apostrophe.

block.bad_start: Type the start as HH:MM, e.g. 09:30.
block.bad_end: Type the end as HH:MM, e.g. 17:00.
block.start_equals_end: Start and end are the same.
block.too_short: Shift too short: at least 15 minutes.
block.too_long: Shift too long: at most 16 hours.

overrides.title: One-off changes
overrides.intro: A day off or different hours for one person on one date. The weekly schedule doesn't change.
overrides.replaceNote: If that person already has a change on that date, it is replaced.
overrides.past_date: The date must be today or later.
overrides.deleteBody: Delete the change for {{name}} on {{date}}? The weekly schedule applies again.

marks.title: Today's marks
marks.intro: Remove a mark only if it was tapped by mistake.

alarms.title: Alarms and settings
alarms.rolloverHint: Shifts starting before this time belong to the previous day's night.
alarms.quitCodeHint: Leave empty to keep the current one.

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: The paired devices. If a device is lost or replaced, unpair it.
devices.revokeBody: Unpair the device "{{name}}"? It will need the passphrase to pair again.
devices.revokeSelf: This is the device you are using now: it will go back to the pairing screen.

changePassphrase.title: Change passphrase
changePassphrase.intro: After the change, Settings lock on every device. Devices stay paired.
changePassphrase.generatedNote: Write it on paper now and keep it away from the shop.
changePassphrase.mismatch: The two new passphrases are not the same.
changePassphrase.doneBody: From now on only the new one works. Settings will lock now.
